subject: Change stat_client_qbuf_limit_disconnections to atomic. (#12711)
reason: The change only converts the stat_client_qbuf_limit_disconnections counter from a plain long long to a redisAtomic long long, switching its single increment (readQueryFromClient), its reset (resetServerStats), and its INFO read (genRedisInfoString) to atomicIncr/atomicSet/atomicGet. It is a thread-safety correctness refactor with no externally observable behavior change: the INFO Stats field client_query_buffer_limit_disconnections reports the same value, the disconnection on exceeding client-query-buffer-limit is unchanged, and no command reply, persistence, replication, or tool behavior chan
